description: For a learner who can perform something at the end of a session, planning later encounters that make them reactivate and use the material, and judging security only on a delayed unaided check, is expected to leave more available at the horizon than treating one fluent exposure as finished; no claim tests this as a whole, only its spacing and retrieval routes and a post-learning exercise-timing effect.
title: Memory Consolidation

description: A learner doing real work in a role or programme new to them, paired over time with a more experienced person who observes that work, responds with modelling and specific feedback, meets regularly, stays out of judging them and hands judgement over, is expected to improve observed practice and persistence; the strongest test in the wiki is a meta-analysis of causal teacher-coaching studies (practice 0.49 SD, students' test scores 0.18 SD, effects shrinking at scale), one randomised student-coaching evaluation found higher persistence but not completion, and one randomised induction study found no first-year gains.
title: Mentoring and Coaching
